requiredIdentity: Specification and referenced schema/fixture/script closure digest
sourceIdentity.rule: Resolve identity fields from the capture manifest, never duplicate or modify captured facts here. A commit alone is insufficient when included working changes exist. Every internal target and external handoff references this one identity. Assembly must stop if it is unbound or incomplete.

steps: Read and validate both consolidation manifests and the reviewed capture identity.
Resolve the current combined checkout's openapi directory; verify its identity and validate all six specification surfaces plus their contract/operation-metadata checks.

Acquire a checkout-local generation lock; pass absolute HEY_HEY_OPENAPI_ROOT to every consumer and shared schema builder. An explicit invalid pin is an error, never a reason to fall back to another checkout.
Generate dependency-ordered targets with their pinned engine/options and full canonical outputs. Use unique run/target staging paths instead of fixed /tmp or shared .openapi-tmp directories.
Apply each target's postprocessors before comparison/promotion. Retain API's nested generation lock, cache and existing atomic generation behavior.
Generate compatible shared schema artifacts once and distribute exact output bytes to their declared destinations. Keep incompatible generator/postprocessor targets separate.

Verify the source closure did not change, promote successful targets with rollback at each output-group boundary, and record source identity, toolchain/options/postprocessor fingerprints and output digests.

Report failure per independent target and finish independent targets where possible. The overall command fails if a required target fails; consumers must not build from an incomplete generation result.
coordinator.atomicity: Per target/output group, not an assumed transaction across every app. UI Common currently writes API and multiple schema outputs in-place, CLI copies five generated files into live directories, and only API's primary generate:api pipeline stages its generated root. Later work must provide staging adapters for all outputs, including files outside src/generated, without deleting handwritten modules or unrelated outputs.
coordinator.lockScope: One root orchestration lock for coordinated runs plus API's existing reentrant model-generation lock shared with Prisma/model generation. Direct consumer commands must participate in their owner lock to avoid racing coordinated generation.
coordinator.cachePolicy: Preserve API's output-aware cache and force escape hatch. Reuse/cache identity includes the complete spec/ref closure, engine, wrapper, options, templates, builders, postprocessors and output digest; do not infer compatibility from a shared spec filename.
coordinator.driftCheck: A clean-checkout CI run regenerates each target and checks its declared outputs for changes. Keep generated files' current tracked/ignored policy until their owning assembly change explicitly accounts for it.
